Aisha (CS): Customer TKT-3421 — payment_initiate calls started failing schema validation after the model swap yesterday. Customer sees a 400 from our tool: 'invalid_arg: amount must be number'.

Aisha (CS): Repro steps we used: included full user prompt + system few-shot. Minimal failing payload we sent to our runtime:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call -d '{\n  \"tool\": \"payment_initiate\",\n  \"args\": {\n    \"currency\": \"USD\",\n    \"amount\": \"$100\",\n    \"recipient\": \"acct_123\"\n  }\n}'
```
Response (tool validation):
```
{"error":"tool_validation_failed","details":"amount expected number but got string \"$100\""}
```

Liam (ENG): Do we have the raw model output (the assistant -> tool call JSON) from the customer trace? Curious whether model produced the $ in the amount or our post-processing introduced it. Could be a few-shot example that uses $100 as a literal.

Aisha (CS): We pulled the model output from their session. The assistant returned:
```json
{"tool":"payment_initiate","args":{"currency":"USD","amount":"$100","recipient":"acct_123"}}
```
If we remove the system/few-shot examples that show money with $ or words ("one hundred dollars") the model emits a numeric 100. So this looks like schema drift caused by instruction/examples.

Jorge (ML): This matches a pattern we saw with xlarge-v2 after its tokenizer/formatting tweak — model more aggressively preserves formatting from examples. Two actionable items: pin affected customers to xlarge-v1 temporarily, and update examples to use plain numerics (no currency symbol, no words). Long-term: add explicit instruction in system prompt to output machine-friendly JSON ("amount must be an integer in cents or a number without symbols").

Liam (ENG): For immediate mitigation I propose a small runtime middleware: strict JSON schema validation with a helpful error message + a coercion pass (strip leading $ and commas, try parseFloat) as a configurable opt-in. I'll raise a PR. We shouldn't silently coerce without logging.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-7890 and escalated to eng-runtime. Pinging @oncall-tooling :rotating_light:

Aisha (CS): Customer is on billing cycle and wants an ETA for a fix. Can we get a hotfix in 24h? :pray:

Liam (ENG): I'll prioritize a hotfix to add a sanitation step for numeric fields in function args. ETA ~12h for a canary, will post PR link shortly.

Jorge (ML): Also adding a note to the model catalog entry for xlarge-v2 about currency/formatting behavior and recommending prompt templates.

Aisha (CS): I'll reply to the customer with the workaround (remove symbols from examples / pin model) and link INF-7890. Thanks. :thumbsup:
